adjustment.analysis: No promotion, price change, or event is planned. The baseline already reflects recent trends and seasonality. The competitor opening across the street introduces a downside risk. Past data shows no clear lift from new competitors, but post-promotion weeks show 24% dip (noise-adjusted x0.76). This week’s baseline is below the 13-week mean, suggesting a downward trend. The competitor entry may reduce demand, but evidence is thin (one past occurrence). Shrink effect toward 1.0. No uplift to justify positive adjustment.
